## Workflow

## Step File
<!-- Exact path to the stage reference where the issue occurred -->
`skills/ultracode-goal/references/{stage}.md`

## Section
<!-- The heading of the section where the issue occurred, as the `section_slug` the command under Fingerprint prints:
     the heading without its leading `#`s and its numbering (`1b.`, `5a-ii.`), lower-cased, each run of other
     characters turned into a hyphen (`1b. Run the formalize readiness check` gives
     `run-the-formalize-readiness-check`). Never a line number. -->


## Severity
<!-- Pick one: `bug` | `friction` | `gap`
     bug      = instructions were wrong or contradictory
     friction = instructions worked but caused back-and-forth or guessing
     gap      = a scenario arose that wasn't covered at all -->


## Fingerprint
<!-- Deterministic dedup key: first 7 hex chars of
     sha1("severity|ultracode-goal/{stage}|skills/ultracode-goal/references/{stage}.md|section-slug|defect-key"),
     each as this issue writes it in Severity, Step File, Section and Defect Key.
     Auto-generated by the health-check workflow. If you are filing this manually, check out the tag that matches
     the Module Version below (a newer checkout can refuse a heading renamed since), write the section's heading
     and the name of the thing the fix would change to a file, names.json:
       {"section_heading": "<heading>", "defect_name": "<name>"}
     and run:
       uv run skills/ultracode-goal/scripts/health_check_fp.py fingerprint --severity <severity> --stage <stage> --stdin < names.json
     Paste its `fp` here, its `legacy_fp` on the Section fingerprint line below, its `section_slug` under Section
     and its `defect_key` under Defect Key. The dedup Action adds the labels from this section and Severity, and
     links your report to any existing canonical issue.
     The section fingerprint is the same hash without "|defect-key": write it on the line below only, never
     as a label; the dedup Action reads it to flag open issues that may report the same defect under another key. -->
`fp-XXXXXXX`

Section fingerprint: `fp-XXXXXXX`

## Defect Key
<!-- One to four lower-case ASCII words joined by hyphens that name the thing the fix would change, in the stage
     reference's or the script's own words: the most specific script (by its file name), subcommand, function,
     flag, field or rule the fix would edit. Give that name as `defect_name` to the command under Fingerprint and
     paste the `defect_key` it prints (`gate_eval.py` gives `gate-eval`, `gate_status` gives `gate-status`). For a
     missing rule, name the case it should cover in two to four of the stage reference's words, never the section's
     subject alone. Never a path, a line number, a severity or words from your run's story. -->
